column1: 390059|HOLD_SCOPE|Both free indecomposability and splitting over infinite cyclic groups, uniformly in the encoded subgroup of Mod_g.|A decision procedure needs a finite input model and termination, not enumeration of splittings. The preceding primary question concerns finitely presented subgroups; the target itself does not specify its input encoding. No algorithm established.

390076|PARK_DEEP|Integral H_1(K_g) finite generation for each g>=3.|Infinite generation of a group does not imply infinite generation of its abelianization. The suggested Laurent-polynomial/tree representation needs an actual image/quotient argument. Historical Theorem5.1 is not adopted as a current reliable premise; no new proof or successor audit.

390088|PARK_DEEP|Determine all k>=1 for both Aut and abstract commensurator of Johnson-filtration terms.|Primary Theorem5.17 covers k=1,2 with genus qualifications nearby; recovering curves from deeper subgroups is a rigidity theorem, not a finite computation. No extrapolation from two terms.

390089|EXCLUDE_KNOWN_PROOF_REQUEST|Alternative elementary proof of Hain's theorem.|The requested novelty is a proof method of an already named theorem; no new theorem credit. Exact Hain theorem and genus conditions absent from literal record; no elementary proof produced.

390091|HOLD_DEFINITIONS|Explicit finite presentation of the mod-2 Lie algebra L_2(I_g,1).|A presentation needs all generators, relators, grading and proof of completeness. The record does not define the lower exponent filtration; nearby source definitions must precede any construction. No finite truncation substitutes for it.

390110|PARK_DEEP|For every pseudo-Anosov, decide both simple closed Teichmueller-geodesic and Veech-curve membership.|Train-track computation alone supplies neither a self-intersection decision nor a Veech-curve criterion with termination. Two independent output obligations; no bounded full-scope route.

390111|PARK_DEEP|Matching-order upper and lower bounds for L(I_g(k)) for all k>=2.|Needs definition of L and dependence on genus and depth. A finite list of dilatations proves no uniform asymptotic order; no matching mechanism.

390163|HOLD_SCOPE|A matrix model calculating Euler characteristics of Arc-complexes.|Arc-complex conventions and matrix integral are in omitted reference28. Merely reusing a known Euler characteristic is not the requested mechanism; no model or exact coefficient identity.

390166|EXCLUDE_KNOWN_INVARIANT_METHOD|Screen-based matrix model for virtual Euler characteristics of compactified moduli.|Record expressly says invariants already known. Screens and compactification need source definitions; a method-only reformulation is not an additional outcome without a new substantive theorem.

390192|HOLD_SCOPE|Mapping-class-group structure explaining graph-manifold Heegaard classification.|A programmatic request with no unique quantified endpoint. Classification theorem44 and equivalence relation absent; no short certificate target extracted.

390196|HOLD_DEFINITIONS|Existence of other surface bundles with unique bundle-related splitting up to equivalence.|Requires exact definition of splitting and equivalence and distinction from trivial monodromy. An example cannot be certified solely by recognizing a product; classification dependencies unread.

390216|HOLD_SCOPE|Ergodicity for free rank r>=3 and compact connected Lie group G.|Primary passage fixes G and Haar measure but outer automorphisms naturally act on conjugacy classes of representations. The literal Hom formulation needs reconciliation; abelian/special SU2 cases do not settle all G. No wording correction credited.

390225|HOLD_DEFINITIONS|Surjectivity of U when k=1, and dense PSL(2,R) image clause.|Domain/codomain of U and meaning of k are missing. Density alone is not a construction of a preimage; no replacement of the actual map by a guessed one.

390226|HOLD_METRIC|Metric completion of curve-complex Gromov boundary related to C(S).|Visual metrics depend on choices and snowflaking; completeness cannot be inferred from the boundary's topological identification alone. Need the intended metric before a completion theorem.

390230|HOLD_SCOPE|A geometric-finiteness theory including Veech-surface groups.|This is a framework request, not a fixed yes/no proposition. Convex cocompactness alone need not include cusp/parabolic behavior of Veech groups. No full-scope mechanism.

390233|PARK_DEEP|Haagerup/a-T-menability of the mapping class group.|Requires proper affine isometric Hilbert action or an actual obstruction. An action on a curve graph does not supply such an action; low genus cases are insufficient.

390243|HOLD_SUCCESSORS|Classify all ergodic SL(2,R)-invariant measures in abelian and quadratic unit-area strata.|Primary gives genus2 as already treated. Measure-rigidity successors are essential before any investment, including finite covers for quadratic differentials; no new classification and no successor body read.

390248|PARK_DEEP|Individual Lyapunov exponents on all known invariant subvarieties, strata, and large-genus limits, with characteristic-number relationship.|Kontsevich's sum formula does not determine individual exponents. Several independent asymptotic/geometric obligations, no finite certificate for the full program.

390259|PARK_DEEP|Every finite-rank subgroup of Whittlesey's group is Schottky.|Pure pseudo-Anosov behavior does not itself give a quasi-isometric orbit/convex-cocompactness proof. Need exact surface and finite-rank convention; no general mechanism.

390275|PARK_DEEP|Every surface subgroup H of Gamma_g is separable.|Separating each outside element by a finite quotient requires a general quotient construction. Residual finiteness of the ambient group alone does not imply subgroup separability.

390277|PARK_DEEP|A closed real-hyperbolic4 manifold fibering with both fiber and base genus2.|Euler characteristic would be16 by multiplicativity, but that necessary integer condition neither constructs nor obstructs a hyperbolic metric. No full existence or nonexistence argument.

390282|HOLD_SCOPE|For all admissible lattices in specified SO/SU families, injections, purely pseudo-Anosov representations and equivariant boundary maps.|Admissibility and PML_0 missing; three different existence/extension questions. Superrigidity analogy is not an exact obstruction theorem under these hypotheses.

390294|HOLD_SCOPE|Describe iwip axis-bundle geometry in Outer space.|Definitions of axis bundle and associated objects are omitted; contractibility or uniqueness would be distinct endpoints. No rigorous bounded classification extracted.

390300|EXCLUDE_WORDING_ENDPOINT|Claim m>=n-1 for virtual epimorphisms to finite-index GL(m,Z).|At m=1 the trivial subgroup of GL(1,Z) has finite index2; the trivial map from Aut(F_n) surjects onto it, violating the inequality for n>=3. The following primary Question2.7 explicitly concerns finite image, explaining intended nontrivial scope. This endpoint loophole earns no credit.

390309|HOLD_SUCCESSORS|Random-walk theory on Outer space analogous to Kaimanovich-Masur.|Needs random-walk measure hypotheses and a concrete convergence/boundary endpoint. Bounded-cohomology method similarity is not a solution or routine-subsumption bridge; successor bodies unread.

390322|PARK_DEEP|Nonzero image of second Morita class in rational H_8(GL(6,Z)).|An explicit source cycle, comparison chain map and nonzero pairing are required; a numerical rank or nonzero class before mapping does not certify its image.

390335|HOLD_DEFINITIONS|Nontriviality of every mu_i for all i>=1.|The cycles and ambient groups vary with i and are absent in the literal record. Finite low-rank calculations cannot settle the entire family; no uniform pairing.

390348|HOLD_SCOPE|Many odd-valent graph classes, comparison with Conant-Vogtmann cycles and image/origin under GL and Torelli maps.|Finding one graph is not the requested structural comparison. Requires definitions of Phi and explicit chain maps; no new full-scope result.

390352|PARK_DEEP|Infinitesimal presentation for homology-cylinder cobordism group generalizing Hain.|Needs Malcev/graded convention and proof all relations generate kernel. Importing a presentation for the Torelli group does not establish one for cylinders.

390354|HOLD_SUCCESSORS|Homology stabilization for discrete diffeomorphisms and discrete symplectomorphisms as genus grows.|Need boundary/stabilization-map conventions and both group families. Stability for ordinary mapping classes is not a bridge to discrete diffeomorphism groups; later stability bodies unread.

390363|HOLD_SUCCESSORS|Existence of theta_6 in pi_126^S, equivalently permanence of h_6 squared.|Adams differentials and extension control are major dependencies. A remembered recent resolution is only a lead here, with no body inspected or priority claim. No bounded new route.

390364|HOLD_DEFINITIONS|Permanence of h_0 h_i at every prime>3 after the recorded proof flaw.|Exact indexing and spectral-sequence conventions needed. The record reports a fatal flaw in the classical proof; neither repeating it nor verifying a finite range supplies the all-primes family.

390384|HOLD_SUCCESSORS|Classify all localizing subcategories of stable k[G]-modules by arbitrary subsets of Proj H*(G,k).|Finiteness of G, characteristic and module-category conventions are omitted. Support-theory classification is a substantial known-literature lead needing theorem-body comparison; no claimed new classification.

390418|PARK_DEEP|Every Q-variety has finitely many components in the closure of its rational points in X(R).|Semialgebraic finiteness of X(R) does not imply finiteness for the closure of X(Q). Need arithmetic control of that subset; no uniform mechanism.

392122|PARK_DEEP|Every synchronizing n-state deterministic automaton has a reset word of length <=(n-1)^2.|Finite search for a chosen n is only a parameter test. A full improvement from cubic general bounds to quadratic requires a global compression mechanism; none supplied.

392636|EXCLUDE_SOURCE_ANSWER|Consistency of any two simple positive-coefficient Ramsey systems.|Source pp52-53 explicitly reports this proved by Hindman-Leader-Strauss and a shorter Leader-Russell proof. Read definitions and resolution passage, not their entire proof bodies. Do not confuse inconsistent Milliken-Taylor systems with these simple systems.

392638|EXCLUDE_SOURCE_THEOREM|lim_{k->infty} gamma_k sqrt(k)=2 with independent uniform length-n words.|Source Theorem1 pp59-60 bounds E[L] between (1+-epsilon)2n/sqrt(k) for all large k and n/sqrt(k)>C, which implies the target by n->infty then k->infty. Read theorem and block/LIS proof outline; full-paper concentration dependencies not audited.

392640|EXCLUDE_SOURCE_THEOREM|For each even k>=4 and k=3, a non-principal pair of k-graphs.|Source p71 Theorem2 is exactly the assertion and includes its stability construction: stable F, cone H of a large clique, and Lemma1 edge-removal contradiction. Read complete local proof; invoked stability theorems not replayed. Odd k>=5 is outside the target.

392652|HOLD_PRIOR_PROOF|kappa(4)=24.|Source pp103-104 discusses Musin's announced proof and optimization mechanism. This is strong prior evidence, not a replay of the exact nonconvex optimization certificate. No new result or full proof-body audit claimed.

392664|PARK_DEEP|At most one nontrivial constrained Nekrasov solution for every mu>3.|The nonlinear denominator couples all earlier s. A naive contraction is not uniform for large mu, and local bifurcation uniqueness does not imply global uniqueness. No monotonicity/comparison theorem established.

392666|PARK_DEEP|Large-data H^(1/2)(R) well-posedness for both signs and every integer k>=2.|Energy control is not a contraction estimate or uniqueness proof. Need precise local/global lifespan endpoint; scaling and endpoint multilinear estimates cannot be replaced by small-data or k-fixed cases.

392684|PARK_DEEP|Every entire transcendental f of order<1/2 admits constants R0,L,delta,C and a good t for every r>R0.|Minimum-modulus results on many radii do not automatically give the stated logarithmic-rate control in every multiplicative interval. No uniform quantitative bridge.

392688|HOLD_DEFINITIONS|Exact AR conformal dimension spectral-radius infimum for all f-stable multicurves, plus nonattainment unless qs sphere.|Need subdivision/expansion hypotheses and lambda definition. Lower bounds from obstructions alone do not prove upper realization or nonattainment. No full route.

392697|PARK_DEEP|Every finite subset of every Gabor frame is linearly independent.|The window and lattice conventions matter. Gram positivity for finitely many examples proves no all-frame theorem; this is an HRT-type independence barrier, not a finite matrix exercise.

392708|HOLD_SCOPE|Coorbit/discrete wavelet study of Besov spaces on symmetric cones via GL(C).|Spaces, cone, admissibility, norms and references2,22,23 are missing. A generic coorbit theorem cannot be applied without verifying representation and kernel hypotheses.

392730|PARK_INTERNAL_BOUNDARY|For every connected simply connected compact Lie group, nonnegative mean1 virtual characters are irreducible absolute squares.|Primary p666 Question has exactly these hypotheses. Its Theorem2 already answers yes for SU2; rank1 polynomial experiments would duplicate that theorem. Higher rank needs a new positivity/factorization mechanism; no successor body or complete proof.

392734|HOLD_PRIOR_SCOPE|Joint distribution of digit sums for coprime bases and arbitrary irrational coefficients.|Primary p685 lists precisely this topic in a survey of recent results, not explicitly as an open conjecture. One-base Fourier factorization does not establish joint decorrelation for different bases. No resolution or novelty inferred from the survey list.

392739|PARK_COMPLEXITY|Uniform polynomial time in both n and d for the stated star-discrepancy bound or a specified weakening.|Source pp697-698 gives probabilistic existence and a moment formula; computing that formula by enumerating n^p terms is not polynomial when p grows with d. Derandomization and bit precision remain substantive, and unspecified weaker estimates cannot be silently chosen.

392742|PARK_INTERNAL_COUNTERMECHANISM|One fixed binary NUT matrix with L2_N<=c sqrt(log N)/N for every N>=2.|Primary pp699-702 defines the sequence and discrepancy, then Theorems5-6 show the all-ones-upper-triangular candidate succeeds on density1 scales but fails on infinitely many scales by log(N)/N. A density1 theorem cannot satisfy the universal N quantifier. No other fixed matrix mechanism.

392778|HOLD_DEFINITIONS|For every non-uniruled projective manifold, equality of modified and ordinary Kodaira dimension.|The record's ba notation needs source definition before comparison with kappa. Abundance-like implications require complete birational-geometric dependencies; no short full-scope route.
